scope: Offline fault injection only: imports/function definitions are AST-loaded, dispatch is excluded, Docker/network are simulated.
checks: apply repairs original rename when candidate rename fails
apply repairs failed worker startup after web startup
rollback works with stopped/restarting candidate without health gate
rollback repairs prior service names after intermediate rename failure
repair refuses to stop an unexpected container
readonly mounted key mutation detected without disclosing content
readonly change during stop aborts and restores original containers
checkpoint copy happens with both original and candidate services stopped
private checkpoint backup survives startup pruning and refuses overwrite
missing state mount and mount outside installation root rejected
cleanup removes only explicitly enumerated stopped fixture containers by ID, without -v
cleanup refuses running containers, unknown image, unexpected mounts and active database sessions
cleanup accepts exact legacy fixture layout and retains all stage artifacts
future authorized repeat after13 uses strict cleanup
catalog uses unique task-owned clone and drops it after success or sample failure
failed catalog creation never drops any existing database
code_review_changes: Recover by immutable container IDs; stop inside compensating try
Persist switch IDs before stopping originals; no automatic database restore
Original AutoRemove must be false; ownership and identity checks
Preserve HostConfig/network membership and private configuration digest
Start web and prove static HTTP readiness before worker
Validate worker baseline sources independently; SDK-only worker overlay
Build contexts contain source only, excluding stage backups/private snapshots
Benchmark report resides in bind mount; complete rows accepted before bounded shutdown
Fingerprint actual readonly mounted config/secrets/runtime, not only historical helper paths
Verify checkpoint bytes unchanged until candidate start; record subsequent changed-file count
Copy checkpoint files to private mode0700 stage, files mode0600, before apply and rollback startup; no automatic overwrite
cleanup-benchmarks requires successful apply and verification, exact approved run numbers, checked image identity/lineage, full preflight and progress record
catalog no longer depends on previously deleted benchmark database; creates/restores isolated clone and drops without FORCE in finally
future documented repeats baseline10..19 and after13..19 covered by strict cleanup
limits: Does not prove real Docker startup/rollback; local deployment verification is performed separately by coordinator.
No data, credentials or installation changed by these tests.
Unix socket exclusion test skipped on Windows because AF_UNIX unavailable; implementation ignores non-regular filesystem entries.
